description: This file defines the 'webPlatform' object implementing the 'Platform' interface, providing platform-specific utilities for web, such as checksum calculation, GUID generation, logging, and stack frame display.

methods.name: calculateSha1
methods.description: Computes the SHA-1 hash of a given string using the Web Crypto API.

methods.name: createGuid
methods.description: Generates a new GUID using cryptographically secure random values.

methods.name: isLogEnabled
methods.description: Determines if logging is enabled for a given logger name ('api' or 'channel').

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs messages to the console with a specified level and message.

methods.name: showInternalStackFrames
methods.description: Indicates if internal stack frames should be shown.
